timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹408.23 Cr (+24.7% YoY), net profit ₹137.59 Cr (+27.2% YoY).
India Shelter Finance reported Q4 FY26 Gross AUM of ₹11,044 Cr and FY26 PAT of ₹503 Cr.

India Shelter Finance Corporation Limited shared the audio recording link for its earnings conference call on March 31, 2026, financial results via **Mukti Chaplot**, signed by **Mukti DigitallyMUKTI CHAPLOT**, on May 4, 2026.
India Shelter Finance Corporation reported Q4 disbursements crossing ₹1,000 Cr and set a target of ₹30,000 Cr AUM by 2030.
Promoters Anil Mehta, WestBridge Crossover Fund LLC, and Aravali Investments Holdings declared no encumbrances on India Shelter Finance shares for FY2026 on April 6, 2026.
CARE Ratings reaffirmed the 'CARE AAA (SO)' rating for India Shelter Finance's Series A1 PTCs on October 27, 2026.
